{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm revenue is string and contains commas
print("Revenue dtype:", sales['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample revenue values:", sales['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print("Number of revenue values with commas:", has_commas.sum())

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Verify the clean conversion
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", sales['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())"}
